wingu.t1: Wingu is a technology NGO that enhances the impact of social projects and initiatives. They promote the technological transformation and digital resilience of non-governmental organizations and social enterprises through training and implementation of innovative technological developments.
wingu.t2: In 2024, Wingu celebrated 10 years of operation in Mexico and we were selected to develop the campaign
wingu.t4: The idea was to use the Mexican cultural imagery to communicate the experience that the organization has in Mexico and to convey that there is solid knowledge about how things work in Mexico and its context.
wingu.t5: A very visually attractive and very fun campaign.
